citeinfo.title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX Orthorectified Image Mosaic
citeinfo.geoform: Grey Scale, Image, Landing Site Map, Remote-sensing Data

descript.abstract:
This is a visible image mosaic generated from the Context Camera (CTX) images from the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter mission. This Science Investigation orthomosaic at 5 m/pixel is matched to the M20_JezeroCrater_CTXDEM_20m DEM and covers the entire Jezero crater. The images were orthorectified using digital terrain models (DTMs) created from CTX stereo images using the Ames Stereo Pipeline.
This mosaic was created in support of the Mars 2020 rover science investigation, which explored Jezero crater to investigate an ancient delta for evidence of past microbial life and to better understand the geologic history of the region.
References: Mangold et al., 2021, Perseverance rover reveals an ancient delta-lake system and flood deposits at Jezero crater, Mars, Science. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.abl4051
Fergason, R. L., Hare, T. M., Mayer, D. P., Galuszka, D. M., Redding, B. L., Smith, E. D., Shinaman, J. R., Cheng, Y., Otero, R. E., 2020, Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation Flight Product Generation: Digital Terrain Model and Orthorectified Image Mosaics, 51st Lunar and Planetary Science Conference.
Malin, M.C. et al., 2007, Context Camera Investigation on board the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter, J. Geophys. Res. 112, E05S04, doi:10.1029/2006JE002808
descript.purpose: This dataset was created to provide contextual imagery for science investigations in Jezero crater, matched to the whole-crater CTX DEM mosaic.

procstep.procdesc: Images orthorectified using CTX DTMs produced with SOCET SET and Ames Stereo Pipeline. DTMs aligned to MOLA. Tone matching and seam blending applied using ASP dem_mosaic tool with 120-pixel linear seam blend.
